provenance.encodes: Oman legislation convention: Royal Decree No. N/YYYY (WIPO Lex: Law on Civil and Commercial Procedure promulgated by Royal Decree No. 29/2002)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/en/legislation/details/22430 and decree.om entries for the Royal Decree No. N/YYYY form.

positive.text: Promulgated by Omani Royal Decree No. 29/2002.
See Royal Decree 6/2020 (Oman) and Sultani Decree No. (42/2013).
Oman Royal Decree No. 55/1990 predates it.

negative: The Royal Decree of Oman was issued.
Omani Royal Decree No. 29 was issued.

note: Needs Oman context: 'Sultani Decree', an 'Oman'/'Omani' prefix or an '(Oman)' suffix. The bare 'Royal Decree N/YYYY' shape is also Spanish, Moroccan and Jordanian; it is the separate low-confidence rule foreign.om.royal_decree.bare. Two-digit years (55/90) are not matched.
